title: Official Inflation Reaches 4.86% for the Year So Far
subtitle: Rosstat recorded price growth of 0.04% in the week to 27 July, taking the July figure to 0.64% and the 2026 total to 4.86%.

source.name: Rosstat weekly consumer price index reported by Interfax

primaryMetric.label: Official price growth so far in 2026

supportingFacts.label: Weekly price growth for 21 to 27 July, a notably quiet reading during a national fuel shortage.
Cumulative price growth recorded for the month up to the same date.
The series sits well below the fuel, haulage and clothing price moves recorded this week.

metadata.keyFinding: Official cumulative inflation for 2026 reached 4.86% by 27 July.
